final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code:

- In pricing.py, parse_price now removes commas and handles parentheses for negative values as accounting style. apply_discount now uses "round half up" rounding mode.
- In export.py, to_csv_row now correctly escapes names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In report.py, low_stock now returns names of items with quantity strictly below the threshold and sorts them alphabetically ignoring case.

These fixes align the code with the docstring specifications and the test cases.

The test run failed due to an environment issue unrelated to the code changes (an OSError in asyncio on Windows). Please run the tests in a proper environment to verify the fixes.
